content.title: Check household eligibility for pantry food
content.description: A visitor checks whether their household can receive pantry food by entering household size and monthly household income, indicating whether someone receives SNAP, and receiving an Eligible or Not eligible result with the applied monthly limit; income at or below the size-based TEFAP limit qualifies, SNAP qualifies regardless of income, and the limit increases by $876 per additional member above eight, while behavior for missing or invalid inputs and required inputs on the SNAP path remains unspecified.
content.summary: Determine pantry eligibility from household size, income, and SNAP status.
content.value: Helps households learn whether they qualify for pantry food under the stated income and SNAP rules.
criteria: The page shows Household size, Monthly household income ($), and Someone in the household receives SNAP inputs, a Check eligibility button, and a result below the button.
Households qualify when monthly income is at or below the monthly limit for their size.
TEFAP monthly limits effective July 1, 2026, at 185% of poverty are: size 1 $2,461; 2 $3,337; 3 $4,212; 4 $5,088; 5 $5,964; 6 $6,839; 7 $7,715; 8 $8,591; add $876 for each member above 8.
A household with someone receiving SNAP is eligible regardless of income.
The result states either “Eligible.” or “Not eligible.” and the applied monthly limit.

props.quote: A visitor checks whether their household can receive food from the pantry.
